'''Evard Cordwyn''' was a hired mercenary captain working for [[Elayne Trakand]].

== Appearance ==
He was tall, with a square jaw and had a large ruby in his left ear.

== Activities ==
He worked for Elayne, pushing back the sorties from [[Arymilla Marne]]. He made a demand of Elayne for more money due to a loss of men. She sent him away with no agreement. Later, he, [[Rhys a'Balaman]] and [[Aldred Gomaisen]] turned coat and attacked the [[Far Madding Gate]]. He died during the attack.
